description:
Departing from Kewalo Harbor—just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana—step aboard our spacious 65’ sailing catamaran, complete with comfortable seating, onboard bathrooms, and a full bar.

Sail the iconic Waikīkī coastline and explore vibrant reef spots where Hawaiian green sea turtles are often spotted gliding through crystal-clear waters. After a breezy cruise, dive in to snorkel among tropical fish, colorful coral, and (with luck) our gentle honu (Hawaiian Sea Turtle).

Perfect for all ages and ideal for both beginners and experienced snorkelers, our welcoming crew ensures a safe, fun, and unforgettable adventure. Relax on deck with Waikīkī’s stunning views—the perfect blend of discovery, comfort, and Aloha spirit.
what_is_included:
- Sailing aboard a 65’ luxury catamaran with comfortable seating, bathrooms, and shaded/open-air areas
- Snorkeling at vibrant Waikīkī reef spots known for Hawaiian green sea turtles and tropical fish
- Use of sanitized snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, and fins)
- Friendly, professional crew to guide and assist snorkelers of all levels
- Complimentary refreshments: beer, wine, tropical cocktails, juice, soda, water, and light snacks
- Stunning views of Waikīkī and Diamond Head from the water
what_is_not_included:
- Optional shuttle available from limited Waikīkī pick up location at an additional fee.
- A 20% tip for the crew is customary and greatly appreciated if you enjoyed your experience. For your convenience, gratuity can be added to your booking at check-out.
highlight_description: Sail from Kewalo Harbor aboard our 65’ catamaran with bathrooms, seating, and a full bar. Snorkel Waikīkī’s vibrant reefs, home to tropical fish and Hawaiian green sea turtles.
check_in_details:
- Departure Times: 8:00 AM, 2:30 PM
- Arrival Time: Please arrive 20 minutes prior to departure (by 7:40 AM, or 2:10 PM) to allow time for check-in and boarding.
- Location: Kewalo Basin Harbor, Slip F28, just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana.
- Check-In Process: Look for the Hawaii Nautical sign outside our slip.
- Parking: Paid parking is available at Kewalo Basin Harbor. We recommend arriving early to secure a spot and walk to the slip.
- Boarding: Boarding closes 10 minutes before departure. Guests arriving late may not be able to join the tour.
what_to_bring:
- Swimsuit and towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (no sprays, please apply before getting onboard)
- Sunglasses and a hat for sun protection
- Reusable water bottle (to help reduce plastic waste, although we have water onboard)
- Optional: Camera or waterproof phone case for photos/videos...don't forget to tag us @hawaiinautical!
faqs:
- **Do I need snorkeling experience?**
*No experience is required! Our experienced crew provides guidance and safety support for beginners, and this trip is great for all ages and comfort levels in the water.*

- **Is snorkeling gear provided?**
*Yes. Sanitized reusable masks, snorkels, and fins are provided on board at no extra charge.*

- **Are drinks and food included?**
*Yes. Enjoy complimentary refreshments: beer, wine, tropical cocktails, juice, soda, water, and light snacks.*

- **Can children join the tour?**
*Absolutely! This sail is family-friendly and safe for kids of all ages. Life jackets are provided for everyone.*

- **Where does the tour depart from?**
*We depart from Kewalo Basin Harbor, Slip F-28, just minutes from Waikīkī and Ala Moana.*

- **What time should I arrive?**
*Please check in 20 minutes before departure (by 7:40 AM) for our 8:00 AM sail and (by 2:10 PM) for our 2:30 PM sail.*

- **Is parking available?**
*Yes. Paid parking is available at Kewalo Basin Harbor. We recommend arriving early to allow time to park and check in.*

- **Will I definitely see turtles?**
*Hawaiian green sea turtles (honu) are frequently seen at our Turtle Canyon snorkel site. While wildlife sightings can’t be guaranteed, we proudly offer our Turtle Guarantee — if you don’t see a turtle, you’re invited to come again free of charge!*

- **What should I bring?**
*Bring a swimsuit, towel, reef-safe sunscreen (non-spray only), sunglasses or hat, and a reusable water bottle. Optional: waterproof camera and a valid ID if you’d like to enjoy alcoholic beverages.*

- **What if I get seasick?**
*Our catamaran is large and very stable, which helps minimize motion on the water. Most guests experience little to no seasickness. If you start to feel unwell, our trained crew is happy to assist and will do their best to make you comfortable throughout the trip.*
